name: Margaret's Spoons
source:
Help Margaret get through the week, and meet up with her crush, Ivan.

You are God (nice one!), and Margaret needs your help to manage her time. She has plenty of boring, adult responsibilities, and not a lot of motivation to do them. Her school friend, Ivan, is back in town, and she'd really like to see him.

[From [url=https://zimtkind.itch.io/margarets-spoons]Itch.io[/url]]
